features.title: Start an agent session in a workspace and stream its messages into the transcript
features.why: #272/#371: reasonChat.ts stored() loads each chat through the registered chat_messages_load and rebuilds it with persist.ts restoreEvents (a turn running at quit reloads as cancelled); apply() and resetReasonChat save through ChatSaver into chat_messages_save (sessions/session_messages), so transcripts survive a restart. #271 still open: configureReason is only called from ReviewButton.tsx, so the main chat opens with no model or effort; the registered claude_* commands have no caller. The sessions row gets only id, claude_session_id and last_user_message_at, and the follow-up queue (queue_order, queue_paused_at) is still in memory. Re-read at a0139339: #365 resolves the main chat's model and effort before session/new (reasonChat.ts:231, WorkspaceView.tsx:120, CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx:164) and provider.rs applies it with session/set_config_option, but only at session/new, not on session/resume. Still Reason-only; queue not persisted. Re-read at 1e73a260: #387 fixes the transcript load race: prompt() waits for the chat's load before deciding new vs resume (reasonChat.ts:142, :260) and copies the stored Session id before reason_open_chat (:133, :273). Options are saved per chat (savedConfig :48, configureReason :362-367) so a Session created after Reset chat keeps model and effort. Still Reason-only, options not re-applied on session/resume (provider.rs:349-353), queue not persisted, sessions row stores no workspace/agent/model/effort. Re-read at 145d9593: Unchanged. #385's only chat change is the turn footer time (view.ts startedAt/endedAt, turnTime.ts); lib.rs only adds the workspace_archive commands. Still Reason-only, options not re-applied on session/resume, queue not persisted.
features.obligation: Add a registered Claude Code / Codex runner. Persist the queue and the full sessions row (workspace_id, agent type, model, effort). Apply model and effort to resumed or live Sessions with set_config_option.

features.obligation: Render assistant text blocks as markdown with inline code, lists and syntax-highlighted code blocks.

features.title: Queue messages while a turn runs: edit, delete, reorder, steer, pause and resume the queue
features.why: New in #303: queue.ts (submit :89, drain :77, turnEnded :108, where a failed turn pauses a non-empty queue, pause/resume :121-128, saveEdit/steerQueued :148/:184, move/reorder) is run by reasonChat.ts setQueue/run (:99-121). Composer QueuePanel (:112) and QueueRow (:157) render a 'Queue paused'/'Queued' header with Pause/Resume, Collapse, and per-row ↑/↓, Edit (Save / Save and steer), Steer and Delete. These are reachable in the app, and the queue behaviour (evidence/chat-queue/README.md) matches. Gaps: the queue lives only in the in-memory Chat (reasonChat.ts:46), and nothing writes queue_order or queue_paused_at, so it is lost on restart. Reorder is buttons, not drag. The chat.queue.* and chat.queueEdit.* keybindings (registry.ts:30) still have no handlers; the edit textarea hard-codes Enter and Escape (Composer.tsx:168-173). Re-read at a0139339: #365 adds drag reorder (Composer.tsx:165-176, queueKeys.ts dropOrder) and binds chat.queue.* / chat.queueEdit.* keys. Still lost on restart: next_queue_order/clear_queue_order have no callers outside openconductor-db; queue_order and queue_paused_at never written. Re-read at 1e73a260: #387 did not change this logic. Drag reorder works; nothing reads or writes queue_order or queue_paused_at, so the queue is lost on restart.
features.obligation: Persist queued messages (session_messages.queue_order) and pause state (sessions.queue_paused_at) through chat_messages_save, and restore them in stored().

features.title: Stop a running turn and mark cancelled messages
features.why: Stop calls the registered reason_cancel (a Stop before the prompt is sent is held for that turn). #339: a stopped prompt shows 'Cancelled' and its turn footer an 'Interrupted by user' badge (Transcript.tsx, view.ts cancelledAt); the e2e waits for the badge. #371: cancelled_at is saved to session_messages and reloaded, and a turn left running at quit reloads as cancelled. Implemented for the Reason runner the app uses; claude_cancel is registered but uncalled. Re-read at 1e73a260: Unchanged verdict. A Stop pressed while the stored transcript is still loading is now handled: the turn is marked unsent before the load wait (reasonChat.ts:258, :260) and cancelled at :277. Side effect: the user message appears only after the load finishes (startTurn at :266).
features.obligation: Render the cancelled-message state ('Interrupted by user' badge driven by cancelledAt) and persist session_messages.cancelled_at. Wire Stop to the Claude Code and Codex runners once they exist.

features.title: Model picker with favorites and per-session thinking/effort level
features.why: Settings › Default models (settings/DefaultModelsPage.tsx) saves models.default, and CreateWorkspaceDialog builds firstSession {agent, model, effort} from it. seedTranscript and sendReason forward only the message text, so the chosen model and effort never reach a running agent. There is no composer picker like menu--model-picker's 'Opus 5 High' chip, no favorites, and no per-session effort, and chat.openModelPicker has no handler. Re-read at 1cedef0: #285 adds settings::launch (claude_launch/codex_launch map models.default/models.review and effort to CLI args), tested but called only from launch_tests.rs. The Reason chat still opens with config [], so the chosen model and effort still never reach the agent (#271). Re-read at a0139339: Moved unwired -> partial (#365): the model and effort now reach the running agent for new main chats (chatModel.ts sessionConfig/defaultChatConfig, WorkspaceView.tsx:120, CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx:164, reasonChat.ts:231; provider.rs session/set_config_option after session/new). Still missing: the stock 'opus' alias maps to no model id (chatModel.test.ts asserts defaultChatConfig(DEFAULT_SETTINGS) is []), effort is hard-coded 'high' for dialog-created workspaces (CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx:46), config is not re-applied on session/resume, no composer ModelPicker/favorites/per-session effort, chat.openModelPicker has no handler, sessions.claude_effort_level/codex_thinking_level never written. Re-read at 1e73a260: One of four #271 gaps half fixed: dialog effort now comes from models.claude_code.default_effort_level / models.codex.default_thinking_level (CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx:100, defaultEffortSetting), but falls back to 'high' when unset (:47), so on stock settings dialog chats send high and other chats send no effort. Still open: opus/sonnet aliases map to no model id (diff/review.ts:130), no re-apply on session/resume, no composer ModelPicker, sessions effort columns never written.
features.obligation: Add the composer model picker (Cmd+/, chat.openModelPicker) with favorite_models and per-session effort, applied to a live Session with set_config_option and persisted to sessions (model, claude_effort_level, codex_thinking_level). Map the Claude aliases to real model ids, and take the dialog's effort from settings or an effort control.

features.title: Revert the workspace to the checkpoint taken at a turn
features.why: #371: resetReasonChat restores through checkpoint_exists/checkpoint_restore, truncates the transcript, and ChatSaver's diffForSave deletes the dropped turns from session_messages. Reloaded turns keep their chatId:uuid turn ids, so checkpoints are found after a restart. The Reason Session is still not rewound (ACP cannot drop turns), so the agent remembers the deleted turns. Re-read at a0139339: Unchanged: resetReasonChat (reasonChat.ts:269-276) restores via checkpoint_exists/checkpoint_restore and truncates the saved transcript; the Reason Session is not rewound or re-seeded. Re-read at 1e73a260: Moved partial -> implemented for the Reason chat (#387). resetReasonChat (reasonChat.ts:312-326) restores the checkpoint, truncates the transcript, clears the stored Session id and calls ChatSaver.rewind, which sets sessions.claude_session_id = NULL and records resume_session_at in the same transaction (chat_messages.rs, chat_store_commands.rs rewind_to). The next prompt opens a new Session with the chat's options and attaches the kept conversation as 'Earlier conversation.md' (rewind.ts:48). Limits: text-only re-seed (no tool output, truncated past 200k chars) instead of resuming at the message; a quick quit before the debounced DB write can restore the old Session id; Claude Code/Codex checkpointing waits on those runners.
features.obligation: Persist turns in session_messages (turn_id), delete messages after the watermark in storage, rewind or re-seed the agent session after a reset, and apply checkpointing to the Claude Code and Codex runners.
